title: Sieve of Eratosthenes
question: Print all primes up to n.
code:
n = int(input())
prime = [True] * (n + 1)
if n >= 0: prime[0] = False
if n >= 1: prime[1] = False
for p in range(2, int(n ** 0.5) + 1):
    if prime[p]:
        for k in range(p * p, n + 1, p): prime[k] = False
print(*[i for i in range(2, n + 1) if prime[i]])
explanation: The sieve marks multiples of each prime as composite.
